🤖 AI models & API keys

Free key: open aistudio.google.com/apikey, sign in with Google, tap Create API key, copy it and paste it here.

If one model's free limit runs out, S automatically tries the other free Gemini models.

Free key: open openrouter.ai/keys, sign in with Google, tap Create API Key, copy it and paste it here. S uses OpenRouter's free models automatically. For photos and PDFs, Gemini works best.

Get one at console.anthropic.com (needs credit under Billing).

Gemini: Google Search agar tumhari key pe allowed ho (free keys pe aksar nahi hota), warna Wikipedia + website reader. Claude: Claude ka apna web search. 🔎 Research mode mein search hamesha on rehta hai.

S hard maths SymPy se exact solve karta hai aur graph banata hai, tumhare browser ke andar. Pehli baar ek hi baar (about 15 MB) download hota hai. Gemini aur Claude ke saath chalta hai.

🎨 Appearance

Off karoge to har chat normal blue rahegi.

👤 Personalization

🔊 Voice

Mic sirf tab chalta hai jab tum 🎤 ya 🗣 dabate ho. Awaazein tumhare phone/browser ki hoti hain.

🧠 Memory

Memory chat history se alag hai: ye chhoti baatein hain (class, exam, pasand) jo S har chat mein yaad rakhta hai. Ye sirf isi browser mein save hoti hai, doosre phone pe sync nahi hoti. Password, phone number jaisi private cheezein S save nahi karta.

🔒 Privacy, security & storage

🔑 Tumhari API keys sirf isi browser mein (localStorage) save hoti hain. Hamara koi server nahi hai. Par dhyaan rakho: browser storage poori tarah "secure" nahi hota. Is phone ko use karne wala ya koi bura browser extension key dekh sakta hai. Isliye: key kisi ko mat do, GitHub pe mat daalo, aur Google AI Studio mein key ko sirf "Generative Language API" tak restrict kar do. Key leak ho jaye to delete karke nayi bana lo.

Storage: checking…

Naye phone pe chats, memory aur Library le jaane ke liye. Backup mein API key nahi hoti.

ℹ️ About

Project S v2.0 · Created by Shivanshu Sharma. ·

Project S

Think. Learn. Create. Grow.

Version 2.0

Project S ek personal AI assistant aur tutor hai jo Hindi, Hinglish aur English mein baat karta hai. Ye ek hi web page hai: koi install nahi, koi server nahi.

Kya kya kar sakta hai

  • 💬 Baat-cheet, padhai, maths, coding, writing aur research
  • 🧮 SymPy maths engine: exact answers aur graphs
  • 🌐 Web search, source links ke saath
  • 📷 Photos, 📄 PDF, Word, TXT aur Markdown samajhna
  • 🎤 Voice typing, 🔊 jawab bol ke sunana, 🗣 voice chat
  • 📚 Study mode: quiz, flashcards, notes · 🧠 Memory · ⭐ Library

AI providers

Google Gemini (free key), OpenRouter (free models) aur Anthropic Claude (paid). Tum apni key daalte ho; S seedha usi provider se baat karta hai.

Privacy

Chats, memory, Library aur keys sirf tumhare browser mein rehte hain. Hum koi data store nahi karte. Sawaal jawab banane ke liye sirf tumhare chune hue AI provider ke paas jaata hai.

📝 Note

Project S

100% free, sirf Google account chahiye.

S ko chalane ke liye ek free Gemini key chahiye. Banane mein bas 1 minute lagta hai:

  1. 🔒 aistudio.google.com/apikey
    Google AI Studio
    1. Ye link kholo
    aistudio.google.com/apikey
  2. 🔒 accounts.google.com
    Sign in
    you@gmail.com
    Next
    2. Google account se sign in karo
    Wahi Gmail jo phone mein hai. Terms aayein to accept karo.
  3. 🔒 aistudio.google.com/apikey
    API keys
    ＋ Create API key
    3. "Create API key" dabao
    Project poochhe to jo pehla dikhe wahi chuno.
  4. 🔒 aistudio.google.com/apikey
    Your API key
    AIzaSy•••••••••••••
    Copy
    4. Key copy karo aur S mein paste karo
    Key AIza se shuru hoti hai.

Pictures sirf samjhane ke liye hain; Google ka asli page thoda alag dikh sakta hai.

🔒 Tumhari key sirf tumhare browser mein save hoti hai. Ye hamare paas nahi aati, aur kisi ko dikhti nahi.

🙈 Key kisi ko mat dena aur GitHub pe mat daalna. Galti se leak ho jaye to aistudio se delete karke nayi bana lo.

Privacy

Hum koi data store nahi karte. S ka koi server nahi hai. Tumhari chats aur key sirf tumhare phone ke browser mein rehti hain.

Jab tum sawaal poochte ho, wo seedha Google Gemini (ya jo brain tumne chuna hai) ko jaata hai taaki jawab mil sake. Free Gemini key par Google apne niyam ke hisaab se messages ko service behtar karne ke liye dekh sakta hai, isliye bahut personal cheezein mat bhejna.

Chats delete karni ho to ☰ → ⚙ Settings → Delete all chats.
